@tobias.rendle The incident history points to **Southgate**, but the thread doesn't state it outright, so treat it as the best match rather than a confirmed site.

The 2025-09-03 messages in #inc-tansley-carrier-api say label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later, Southgate cleared the backlog and labels printed again. Priyanka or Hollis, who were in that incident, can confirm the site before your customer call.
